Not
yet Better
My grandmother gives me a lucky money. My grandmother gives me lucky money.
Why
it
matters: The public grammar descriptor for Band 5 asks for basic sentence forms 'with reasonable
accuracy'. Articles appear in almost every sentence, so ﬁxing them raises accuracy everywhere at once — and
you already get many 'nothing' slots right.
Practice
Write a, an, the — or a dash (—) for nothing. Then say the sentence out loud and say WHY: ﬁrst time, second
time, only one, or in general.
Article
doctor
1. She was ___ Vietnamese teacher.
2. I had ___ maths teacher. ___ teacher taught me for three years. (two parts, write both with a slash)
3. I think ___ patience is ___ important quality for a teacher. (two parts, write both with a slash)
4. I study ___ maths, but sometimes I study ___ physics. (two parts, write both with a slash)
5. I often buy ___ clothes through ___ app. (two parts, write both with a slash)
6. I don't have to go to ___ shop.
7. I like ___ Vietnamese music because I can understand ___ words. (two parts, write both with a slash)
8. I have never played ___ instrument.
9. In ___ evening I usually take ___ rest. (two parts, write both with a slash)
10. I buy ___ new food or ___ clothes online. (two parts, write both with a slash)
Three
slots:
a
special
day
11. My family always cooks ___ big meal on that day.
12. We usually visit ___ house of my grandparents.
13. I like ___ traditional food more than modern food.
14. She gave me ___ present I still keep.
15. It is ___ very important day for my family.
16. In my country ___ people celebrate for three days.
17. My mother makes ___ cake every year.
18. ___ street near my house is full of ﬂowers.
19. I never eat ___ meat on that morning.
20. He is ___ only person who remembers the old songs.
Room
tour
First, describe the room you are in to a friend on the phone: say each thing, then say something about it. Then
ﬁx three sentences Band 5 learners commonly say.
21. Describe ﬁve things in your room: a door, a window, a table, chairs, a light.
22. Say it better: 'I eat a food from my hometown every week.'
23. Say it better: 'My birthday is on the June.'
24. Say it better: 'At New Year my grandmother sends me a lucky money.'
Talk
for
60
seconds

Say: “Last lesson was about widening. Today we ﬁnd out how far your story really goes.”
